title: Quinoa
notes: Ratio by volume: 1 volume quinoa, 2 volumes water.

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.prep: rinsed until the water runs clear

steps.text: Put {water} and a pinch of salt in a pan, add {quinoa} and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to the lowest heat and simmer until the water is absorbed and the grains show a little white spiral.
Take off the heat and leave covered.
Fluff with a fork and season to taste.
